post_wise_breakdown.title_of_project: Deep-Test-All: A Genetic Algorithm-Based Framework for Robust Testing of Deep Learning Models in Antimicrobial Resistance Diagnostics and Therapeutics
Developing an Interpretable and Efficient Machine Learning Framework to Predict Antimicrobial Resistance towards Drugs

selection_process: Selection process consists of a written test and an interview in Physical Mode at NIT Kurukshetra.

Only the shortlisted candidates will be informed about the written examination and interview schedule via email. The syllabus for the written examination in the respective disciplines is as per their GATE/NET curriculum. Candidates who have qualified GATE/NET or any other national level examination are exempted from the written examination.
how_to_apply: Download the application form in prescribed format available at the official link.
Fill out the application form carefully with all required details.
Scan all relevant educational certificates properly into a single PDF file.
Submit the application file through the official Google form link.
Ensure the application is submitted on or before 20.10.2026, 11:59 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected. The qualifications listed are minimum requirements and do not guarantee an invitation to the written test and/or interview. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview/written test. The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information and other documents submitted. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Candidates must provide valid e-mail IDs in their application to receive test and interview updates. Final-year Master's students must submit their final-semester results by 30th November 2026 if selected.

content_sections.text: Not specified in the notification Applicants in the final year of their Master’s programme who have submitted their dissertation/thesis but do not have their final-semester results by the application deadline may apply for the JRF position, provided they submit the results by 30th November 2026. CSIR/UGC-NET or GATE qualification

rows.qualification_required: Post-graduation Engineering/Technology with 60% aggregate marks/ Average (CGPA) 6.5 on a 10-point scale for GEN (marks will be relaxed by 5% or by a CGPA of 0.5 on a 10-point scale for SC/ST/PwD candidates) from a UGC recognized University/ Institute/ Autonomous bodies. OR Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology or equivalent with a minimum of 75% marks in aggregate or 8.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale or equivalent.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for 02 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions under the ANRF PAIR SAKSHAM research project at NIT Kurukshetra in collaboration with IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 02 vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 20.10.2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JRF?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post-graduation Engineering/Technology degree with 60% marks (or 6.5 CGPA) or a full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology with a minimum of 75% marks (or 8.0 CGPA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on the last date of application.
